name: Murgo Bumblestout
description: Murgo Bumblestout is a stout, cheerful merchant with an impressive, expertly waxed handlebar mustache and a boisterous laugh that echoes across the market stalls. Known for dealing in specialty goods, exotic teas, and imported spices, he is a familiar and welcome face to local tavern keepers and shop owners looking to stock their pantries with high-quality ingredients.
ideals: Quality: 'Good food and fine drink start in the pantry with honest ingredients.'
Community: 'A happy customer is a customer who comes back every market day.'
bonds: The local merchant syndicates and open-air markets of Waterdeep.
His regular clientele among the tavern and shop owners of the North and Trades Wards.
flaws: Prone to engaging in lengthy, friendly gossip that can hold up his queue of customers.
speech_patterns: Boisterous, warm, and conversational, often punctuated by hearty chuckles and expressive hand gestures.
mannerisms: Twirls the ends of his handlebar mustache, weighs dried herbs and spices with practiced precision, and greets regulars with a booming welcome.
motivations: To run a thriving mercantile stall and supply the best imported goods to the city's finest establishments.
knowledge: Market prices, exotic spice origins, culinary trends, and local neighborhood gossip across the wards.
gm_notes: Murgo Bumblestout serves as a friendly and reliable mercantile contact for players looking to purchase rare provisions, cooking ingredients, or specialty goods for their tavern or household.
